name: [UPD] Highest Bounce?⚡
desc:
UNLOCK tramps, BOUNCE high, and MUTATE your tramps! 🧬✨

[How To Play]
• 💸 JUMP on your tramp for $$$
• 🔥 PURCHASE epic tramps to jump even higher! 
• 💰 SELL your tramp for Upgrade Tickets!
• 🧬 MUTATE your tramps for bonus Upgrade Tickets!
• 🔁 REBIRTH to unlock powerful new tramps!
• 🌧️ WEATHER happens every 10-15 minutes and gives random Mutations!

How high can YOU bounce? How rich can you get? 😈
👉 Buy. Mutate. Sell. Rebirth.
